description.value: Session Taproom + Kitchen is a casual, artisanal restaurant and craft-beer taproom that has operated in Campbell River since 2019, featuring 12 rotating taps of local craft beer and cider alongside cocktails, pizza, and salad bowls. The business is kid-friendly and locally owned, with an emphasis on locally sourced ingredients and staff. It shares its building with a spin and yoga studio, making it a lively community gathering spot on the Island Highway corridor.
